meta.title: [Blazor] Make _serializerCache static readonly to avoid creating dictionaries per instance
meta.body_summary: Make _serializerCache static readonly in Blazor's PersistentStateValueProvider to share serializer cache across instances, reducing memory and improving performance.

perf_labels.notes: One-line static field change; approved after CI green; low-risk memory sharing optimization.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Extremely small 2-line change, a one-word modifier addition to a field declaration. This is a minimal, low-risk performance micro-optimization that aligns with fast-merge approval norms.

review_details.performance_claim: Making _serializerCache static reduces memory allocation by sharing the cache across all instances of PersistentStateValueProvider.
